en.headline: Mainland man found dead in Mai Po fish pond, employer arrested
en.dek: Police recovered the body of a 37-year-old man early Monday and arrested a 70-year-old pond owner on suspicion of employing an illegal worker.
body: Police said officers responded to a missing-person report at about 10.24pm on Sunday and located a man lying in a fish pond off Tam Kon Chau Road in Mai Po. Firefighters recovered the body at around 1am, and the man was certified dead at the scene.

Initial enquiries indicated the deceased was a 37-year-old mainland man surnamed Wong who had been working illegally. Officers arrested a 70-year-old man surnamed Tung, the operator of several fish ponds at the location, on suspicion of employing a person not lawfully employable.

The case is being treated as a body found and employing an illegal worker. The Border District Crime Squad is investigating, and the cause of death is subject to an autopsy. The man’s wife, who lives on the mainland, had contacted friends in Hong Kong after losing contact with him.

zh.headline: 米埔魚塘發現內地男子屍體 僱主涉聘黑工被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨將37歲男子遺體撈起，並拘捕70歲塘主，涉嫌僱用非法勞工。
body: 警方表示，周日晚上約10時24分接獲失蹤報告，其後在米埔担竿洲路一個魚塘發現一名男子倒臥水中。消防員約凌晨1時將遺體救起，事主當場證實死亡。
初步調查顯示，死者為37歲內地男子姓黃，相信是非法勞工。警方拘捕一名70歲姓董男子，他是現場多個魚塘的負責人，涉嫌僱用非法勞工。
案件暫列作屍體發現及僱用非法勞工，交由邊境警區重案組跟進，死因有待驗屍確定。死者在內地的妻子因失聯向在港友人求助，從而揭發事件。
